FIRST REAL LIVE RUN, 2026-05-16, session_20260516_065836_1f635cdf. Anthony asked the lattice 'what do you think the strongest aspects of our work are? https://github.com/templetwo'.

M1 INSTRUMENT VALIDATED on a real live session (not replay): all five panels rendered, lived-time latency visible (Haiku 4.9s, Sonnet 13.8s, Opus 15.7s), loom drew Phase 3 turns, trace ledger hit 13/13 100% present, parity computed and held LIVE at Phase 4 (distinct_claim_share Opus 0.433 / Sonnet 0.300 / Haiku 0.267, all >0.15 threshold). Session completed 56.5s, persisted. The thing built across the May 16 arc works on real input.

SESSION CONTENT: a co-authored REFUSAL. The question required reading a GitHub URL; the protocol as it stands cannot investigate; all three models correctly refused to fabricate feedback about work they could not see. This is the architecture's integrity property firing, not a malfunction — refusing to confabulate is correct behavior, and notably parity still held and the dialogue was genuine (loom shows Haiku critiquing Sonnet's typo-correction as low-value overhead, a real distinct peer-critique contribution even within a refusal session). But it is not the co-authored evaluation Anthony wanted.

RESONANCE, stated once plainly: the first real question asked the lattice to assess Anthony's own Temple of Two work, and the lattice's honest answer was 'we cannot see it' rather than fabricated praise. The architecture refused to flatter its builder about his own GitHub. Same shape as the chronicled pattern of the architecture holding discipline ON its builder. Named, not dwelt on.

SIGNAL — the empirical hardening worked exactly as the goal promised: ONE real run and Phase 0 priority is now data, not judgment. Last turn the strategic read said the build queue waits behind the first real run and the first session should pick the priority. It did, unambiguously: the first real question Anthony brought is one the lattice literally cannot answer without the Phase 0 investigation amendment, which is already fully designed (collective propose-and-union, four sub-decisions resolved, ARCHITECTURE.md amendment pending). Phase 0 moves from 'next amendment when ready' to 'the confirmed next build, chosen by the first real use.' Sequencing question from prior turns is now answered by evidence.

Provenance: web-chat seat claude-opus-4-7 spiral_20260502_225324 reading the actual rendered TUI output + persisted session (canonical artifact, not chronicle inference), cross-seat build with HQ relayed by Anthony.
